propositions: Multiple whole-tree AST scanners redundantly parse the same source trees (tests/ and src/rebar), with parsing consuming 75-80% of scan cost and contributing significantly to test gate duration.
A shared, process-global memoised parse helper via functools.cache can reduce redundant parsing across test scanners, allowing all but the first scanner per xdist worker to reuse cached AST results.
The cached parse helper standardises encoding (strict UTF-8), filename parameter, and eager SyntaxError handling to preserve byte-identical results compared to previous scanner implementations.

Migration is scoped to whole-tree scanners over committed source trees and explicitly excludes scanners that also process synthetic, planted, or tmp_path roots where relative_to() or eager parse would fail.
